name: web-researcher-mcp
description: Search the web and primary sources, read pages behind your logins, verify citations. Runs locally. Web search, full-page reading, academic, patent, legal, filings and economic research. Opt-in encrypted logins let it read pages you can already open. A trust suite catches fabricated, retracted or mischaracterized citations. Sessions, saved searches and memory persist across chats. Zero-config with DuckDuckGo; connect Brave, Serper, Tavily, Exa or others for richer results.
